airtable.note: IDs live in shared-config.md — listed here only as the set this agent touches.

schedule.note: Monday morning so the week's asks land before the client's weekly email goes out and before the team sync. Adjust cronUtc for CST (0 13 * * 1) when DST ends.

answerSurface.note: The answer-surface reading is run by a person in ChatGPT + Claude, not by the agent. BASELINE is BLOCKED on it — no client brief ships without a human_check:true observation. WEEKLY is non-blocking: the agent puts a 2-question paste-ready pack at the top of the digest and continues, tracking skips.
answerSurface.instructions: new chat per question, web search on, paste the raw answer back
answerSurface.runBy: Danny (default) — reassign per client if someone else owns the relationship

pilot.note: Start with 2–3 clients who already have voice bundles and an active Ordinal queue, then widen. Each entry needs clients/<slug>/pillars.json before its first weekly run.
